applications_rules_check.name: applications_rules_check
applications_rules_check.value: "applications"."rules_accepted_at" is not null or "applications"."crew_application_id" is not null

event_invitations_event_email_key.name: event_invitations_event_email_key
event_invitations_event_email_key.where: "event_invitations"."email" is not null and "event_invitations"."user_id" is null and "event_invitations"."status" = 'pending'

media_contents_link_check.name: media_contents_link_check
media_contents_link_check.value: "media_contents"."kind" <> 'link' or "media_contents"."url" is not null or "media_contents"."deleted_at" is not null

pro_profiles_siret_key.name: pro_profiles_siret_key
pro_profiles_siret_key.where: "pro_profiles"."deleted_at" is null and "pro_profiles"."siret" is not null

vehicles_proposed_make_check.name: vehicles_proposed_make_check
vehicles_proposed_make_check.value: "vehicles"."proposed_make" is null or char_length("vehicles"."proposed_make") between 2 and 40

vehicles_proposed_model_check.name: vehicles_proposed_model_check
vehicles_proposed_model_check.value: "vehicles"."proposed_model" is null or char_length("vehicles"."proposed_model") between 2 and 40
